Hour (0-23). Up/Down keys and the mouse wheel change it by one. Pasting a date and time (2026/10/24 19:30) fills the whole row.
Minute (0-59). Up/Down keys and the mouse wheel change it by one. Pasting a date and time (2026/10/24 19:30) fills the whole row.
